overview: This batch focuses on finalizing the ultra-endgame simulation loop by implementing deterministic state compression for long-running sessions and optimizing the Monte Carlo survival rate calculation. These atomic tasks ensure memory stability and precise statistical reporting for the 5,500+ tick campaign, closing the final gaps in simulation fidelity and resource management.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Compressor
acceptance_criteria: Hash chain updates in O(1) time.
Deterministic hash remains stable across identical tick sequences.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Ensures save/load consistency and reduces memory fragmentation during long campaigns.

tasks.title: Optimize Monte Carlo Survival Rate Calculator
acceptance_criteria: Calculator maintains a fixed-size circular buffer of 1000 samples.
Average survival rate is computed in O(N) with N=1000.
No dynamic memory allocation during calculation.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Provides immediate, accurate feedback on colony viability without performance hitches.

tasks.title: Add Tick-Count Metadata to Save Files
acceptance_criteria: Metadata is serialized at the start of the save file.
Deserialization correctly restores tick count and timestamp.
Backward compatibility with v1.1.0 saves is maintained via version check.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Allows players to track precise campaign duration and compare runs efficiently.
